name: Azava
description: Azava runs automations for investors and deal-driven teams. Describe an effect — "when I forward a pitch email, get the company into Attio"; "get founder updates into our tracking sheet" — and Claude builds it with Azava's tools: connect your systems, rehearse on real data, then set it live. Azava's engine then runs it the same way every time, pausing to ask you when a decision needs a human.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Azava to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Azava to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.azava.com/api/v1/mcp/automation. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Azava MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Azava lists 27 MCP tools, including addCreditLink, checkRun, confirmWhatsappCode, connectSystem, deleteAutomation, describeConnection, getAutomation, getBilling, grantAccess, inspectRun, linkWhatsappNumber, and listAutomations.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Azava?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Azava in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Azava requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Azava is developed by Azava. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
